coverage_explanation: Checks classification safety at a constant valid temperature just above 30.0: the below-threshold message must never be printed. The input is constant from startup, so there is no transition deadline or stale-reading ambiguity. No minimum report count or reporting interval is enforced. Silence is inconclusive for reading/reporting liveness, not a demonstrated success for the complete requirement. Below-threshold classification, dynamic response, and continued reporting remain untested because the requirement supplies no response-time bound and this check schema cannot express an inconclusive timeout.
assumptions: The explicitly wired DHT22 on digital pin 2 is the temperature source; no bench-default wiring is used.
The supplied serial baud rate is 9600.
The note that serial input is a float specifies no serial-driven behavior or command grammar; no serial input is injected.
The initial temperature stimulus is effective before setup and remains constant throughout the test.
No maximum sampling or reporting interval is specified. The finite observation horizon is not treated as a required reporting deadline.
Equality and invalid-reading behavior are unspecified. The reference chooses the below message at equality and skips invalid readings; neither choice is asserted.
